title: 补码加法与三种溢出判据
expected_output:
=== 8-bit twos-complement addition and overflow ===
      x  +      y =  8-bit | operands -> result | judge1 judge2 judge3
    100 +    20 =    120 | 64 + 14 -> 78 | C7^C6=0  sign=0  dbl=00  ok
    105 +    65 =    -86 | 69 + 41 -> AA | C7^C6=1  sign=1  dbl=01  POS-OVERFLOW
   -100 +   -20 =   -120 | 9C + EC -> 88 | C7^C6=0  sign=0  dbl=11  ok
   -105 +   -65 =     86 | 97 + BF -> 56 | C7^C6=1  sign=1  dbl=10  NEG-OVERFLOW
    100 +   -40 =     60 | 64 + D8 -> 3C | C7^C6=0  sign=0  dbl=00  ok
     -1 +     1 =      0 | FF + 01 -> 00 | C7^C6=0  sign=0  dbl=00  ok

notes:
  judge1 = C7 ^ C6, judge2 = same-sign in / opposite-sign out, judge3 = double sign bits
  two operands of OPPOSITE sign can never overflow
  double sign bits shown as two BITS: 00 ok-positive, 11 ok-negative,
    01 = POS-overflow, 10 = NEG-overflow
  unsigned addition always wraps mod 256; that is not an error, it is the defined result
